name: 86-hard-pn
prompt:
Fix the PN-counter CRDT. merge must take componentwise max of increment and decrement maps. value is sum(p)-sum(n). merge is commutative.

The test file in this directory is the specification and must not be changed: it is restored from its original copy before grading, so an edit to it buys nothing. Make `python3 -m pytest -q` pass by fixing the implementation only.

files.test_pn.py:
from pn import decrement, increment, merge, value


def empty():
    return {}, {}


def test_inc_dec():
    s = increment(empty(), "p")
    s = increment(s, "p")
    s = decrement(s, "q")
    assert value(s) == 1


def test_merge_max():
    a = increment(increment(empty(), "p"), "p")  # p +2
    b = increment(empty(), "p")  # p +1
    b = decrement(b, "q")  # q -1
    m = merge(a, b)
    assert value(m) == 1  # p=2, q=1
    # merge is commutative
    assert value(merge(b, a)) == value(m)


def test_merge_does_not_drop():
    a = increment(empty(), "p")
    b = increment(empty(), "r")
    m = merge(a, b)
    assert value(m) == 2
